name: Mexico
overview:
“Viva Mexico!”, we scream as a military parade rolls through the centre of Mexico City. Serendipitously, we landed for Mexican Independence Day, making for the best first impression of our travels so far!

Mexico is a 10 / 10 for travel and is among our favourite countries. It has rich history, a modern megacity, incredible biodiversity, and tacos!
